name: dsh-sidebar-vscode
description: DSH web plugin: a better-sidebar tab that embeds the VS Code web workbench opened at the current session workspace — same-origin by default through the plugin's built-in reverse proxy (/sidebar/vscode), or via a gateway subpath / any configured editor base URL. Editor selections land as <text-selection> context chips; explorer files/folders land as path-only <file-selection>/<folder-selection> markers.
